title.zh: 卷51 列傳第16 長孫覽
title.raw: 卷51 列傳第16 長孫覽 Volume 51 Biographies 16: Zhang Sunlan

sentences.zh: 長孫覽長孫覽，字休因，河南洛陽人也。

translations.literal: Zhangsun Lan—Zhangsun Lan, style name Xiuyin, was a man of Luoyang in Henan.
translations.idiomatic: Zhangsun Lan, whose style name was Xiuyin, came from Luoyang in Henan.

sentences.zh: 祖稚，魏太師、假黃鉞、上党文宣王。

translations.literal: His grandfather Zhi was Wei Grand Preceptor, acting holder of the Yellow Battle-Ax, and Prince Wenxuan of Shangdang.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Zhi had served as Grand Preceptor of Wei, held the ceremonial Yellow Battle-Ax, and been enfeoffed as Prince Wenxuan of Shangdang.

sentences.zh: 父紹遠，周小宗伯、上党郡公。

translations.literal: His father Shaoyuan was Zhou Minor Director of the Ancestral Temple and Duke of Shangdang commandery.
translations.idiomatic: His father Shaoyuan had been Zhou Minor Director of the Ancestral Temple and Duke of Shangdang.

sentences.zh: 覽性弘雅，有器量，略涉書記，尤曉鐘律。

translations.literal: Lan was by nature magnanimous and refined, possessed capacity and breadth, had some acquaintance with written records, and was especially versed in pitch pipes and musical regulation.
translations.idiomatic: Lan was magnanimous and refined by nature, possessed breadth of character, had some training in clerical work, and was especially expert in pitch pipes and musical regulation.

sentences.zh: 魏大統中，起家東宮親信。

translations.literal: In the Great Concord era of Western Wei he first entered service as an Eastern Palace trusted attendant.
translations.idiomatic: During the Great Concord era of Western Wei he began his career as a trusted attendant in the Eastern Palace.

sentences.zh: 周明帝時，為大都督。

translations.literal: Under Emperor Ming of Zhou he served as Grand Commander.
translations.idiomatic: Under Emperor Ming of Zhou he served as Grand Commander.

sentences.zh: 武帝在籓，與覽親善，及即位，彌加禮焉，超拜車騎大將軍。

translations.literal: When Emperor Wu was still in the fief, he was on intimate terms with Lan; after he took the throne he treated him with still greater ceremony and promoted him in one step to Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: While still a prince, Emperor Wu had been on close terms with Lan; once he took the throne he honored him all the more and promoted him straightaway to Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry.

sentences.zh: 每公卿上奏，必令省讀。

translations.literal: Whenever the high ministers submitted memorials, he invariably had Lan review and read them.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever senior officials submitted memorials, the emperor always had Lan review them first.

sentences.zh: 覽有口辯，聲氣雄壯，凡所宣傳，百僚屬目，帝每嘉歎之。

translations.literal: Lan had eloquence in speech and a voice vigorous and strong; whatever he proclaimed and transmitted, the hundred officials fixed their eyes upon him, and the emperor often praised and sighed over him.
translations.idiomatic: Lan was a gifted speaker with a powerful, resonant voice; whenever he delivered the emperor's pronouncements the entire court watched him, and the emperor often expressed his admiration.

sentences.zh: 覽初名善，帝謂之曰：「朕以萬機，委卿先覽。

translations.literal: Lan's original given name was Shan. The emperor said to him, "I entrust the myriad affairs of state to you for prior review."
translations.idiomatic: Lan had originally been named Shan. The emperor told him, "I am entrusting the myriad affairs of state to you for prior review."

sentences.zh: 」遂賜名焉。

translations.literal: " He thereupon bestowed the name Lan upon him.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor thereupon bestowed upon him the name Lan.

sentences.zh: 及誅宇文護，以功進封薛國公。

translations.literal: When Yuwen Hu was executed, he was advanced in enfeoffment for merit as Duke of the State of Xue.
translations.idiomatic: After Yuwen Hu was executed, he was promoted for his service and enfeoffed as Duke of Xue.

sentences.zh: 其後曆小司空。

translations.literal: Thereafter he successively held the post of Junior Minister of Works.
translations.idiomatic: He later served as Junior Minister of Works.

sentences.zh: 從平齊，進位柱國，封第二子寬管國公。

translations.literal: He followed in the pacification of Qi, was advanced to Pillar of State, and enfeoffed his second son Kuan as Duke of the State of Guan.
translations.idiomatic: He took part in the conquest of Qi, was promoted to Pillar of State, and enfeoffed his second son Kuan as Duke of Guan.

sentences.zh: 宣帝時，進位上柱國、大司徒，俄曆同、涇二州刺史。

translations.literal: Under Emperor Xuan he was advanced to Senior Pillar of State and Grand Minister of Education, and soon after served successively as inspector of Tong and Jing provinces.
translations.idiomatic: Under Emperor Xuan he was promoted to Senior Pillar of State and Grand Minister of Education, and soon afterward served in turn as inspector of Tong and Jing provinces.

sentences.zh: 高祖為丞相，轉宜州刺史。

translations.literal: When Emperor Gaozu was Chancellor, Lan was transferred to be inspector of Yi province.
translations.idiomatic: When Yang Jian was still Chancellor, Lan was transferred to serve as inspector of Yi province.

sentences.zh: 開皇二年，將有事於江南，征為東南道行軍元帥，統八總管出壽陽，水陸俱進。

translations.literal: In the second year of Kaihuang, when the court was about to undertake operations in the Jiangnan region, he was summoned as campaign commander of the Southeast Circuit and, commanding eight area commanders, marched out from Shouyang with land and water forces advancing together.
translations.idiomatic: In Kaihuang year 2, as the court prepared operations in the south, he was appointed campaign commander of the Southeast Circuit, led eight area commanders out from Shouyang, and advanced by land and water together.

sentences.zh: 師臨江，陳人大駭。

translations.literal: When the army reached the Yangzi, the people of Chen were greatly alarmed.
translations.idiomatic: When the army reached the Yangzi, Chen was thrown into alarm.

sentences.zh: 會陳宣帝卒，覽欲乘釁遂滅之，監軍高熲以禮不伐喪而還。

translations.literal: It happened that Emperor Xuan of Chen died; Lan wished to seize the opportunity and destroy Chen, but the army supervisor Gao Feng, citing the rite of not attacking a state in mourning, withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xuan of Chen died, Lan wanted to exploit the occasion and destroy Chen outright, but the army supervisor Gao Feng cited the rule against attacking a state in mourning and ordered the withdrawal.

sentences.zh: 上常命覽與安德王雄、上柱國元諧、李充、左僕射高熲、右衛大將軍虞慶則、吳州總管賀若弼等同宴，上曰：「朕昔在周朝，備展誠節，但苦猜忌，每致寒心。

translations.literal: The emperor often ordered Lan to feast together with Prince Xiong of Ande, Senior Pillar of State Yuan Xie, Li Chong, Left Vice Director Gao Feng, Right Guards General Yu Qingze, and Wu province area commander He Ruobi, and the emperor said, "In former days in the Zhou court I fully displayed loyal devotion, yet I suffered from suspicion and was repeatedly chilled at heart."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor often had Lan dine with Prince Xiong of Ande, Senior Pillar of State Yuan Xie, Li Chong, Left Vice Director Gao Feng, Right Guards General Yu Qingze, and Wu province area commander He Ruobi, and said to them, "In the Zhou court I gave my full loyalty, yet I was plagued by suspicion and constantly chilled at heart."

sentences.zh: 為臣若此，竟何情賴？

translations.literal: To be a minister in such circumstances—upon what feeling could one rely?
translations.idiomatic: To serve as a minister under such conditions—what loyalty could one count on?

sentences.zh: 朕之於公，義則君臣，恩猶父子。

translations.literal: Between myself and you gentlemen, in righteousness we are ruler and ministers, yet in kindness we are like father and sons.
translations.idiomatic: Between us, in duty we are ruler and ministers, yet in affection we are like father and sons.

sentences.zh: 朕當與公共用終吉，罪非謀逆，一無所問。

translations.literal: I shall share lasting good fortune with you gentlemen; unless the crime is treasonous plotting, I shall question nothing.
translations.idiomatic: I intend to share lasting good fortune with you; unless the offense is outright treason, I shall question nothing.

sentences.zh: 朕亦知公至誠，特付太子，宜數參見之，庶得漸相親愛。

translations.literal: I also know your utmost sincerity and have especially entrusted you to the Crown Prince; you should frequently attend upon him, so that you may gradually become mutually affectionate.
translations.idiomatic: I know your utmost loyalty and have especially entrusted you to the Crown Prince; you should visit him often so that you may gradually grow close.

sentences.zh: 柱臣素望，實屬於公，宜識朕意。

translations.literal: The longstanding esteem due a pillar minister truly belongs to you gentlemen; you should understand my intent.
translations.idiomatic: The longstanding esteem owed a pillar of the state truly belongs to you; understand what I mean.

sentences.zh: 」其恩禮如此。

translations.literal: " His favor and ceremony were such as this.
translations.idiomatic: " His favor and ceremony toward them were of this order.

sentences.zh: 又為蜀王秀納覽女為妃。

translations.literal: He also had Lan's daughter taken in marriage as consort for Prince Xiu of Shu.
translations.idiomatic: He also had Lan's daughter marry Prince Xiu of Shu as his consort.

sentences.zh: 其後以母憂去職。

translations.literal: Thereafter he left office on account of mourning for his mother.
translations.idiomatic: He later left office to observe mourning for his mother.

sentences.zh: 歲餘，起令復位。

translations.literal: After more than a year he was recalled and ordered to resume his post.
translations.idiomatic: After more than a year he was recalled to his post.

sentences.zh: 俄轉涇州刺史，所在並有政績。

translations.literal: Soon he was transferred to be inspector of Jing province; in every place he served he had administrative achievements.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon transferred to inspector of Jing province, and everywhere he served he left a record of good governance.

sentences.zh: 卒官。

translations.literal: He died in office.
translations.idiomatic: He died in office.

sentences.zh: 子洪嗣。

translations.literal: His son Hong succeeded him.
translations.idiomatic: His son Hong succeeded him.

sentences.zh: 仕曆宋順臨三州刺史、司農少卿、北平太守。

translations.literal: In office he successively served as inspector of the three provinces Song, Shun, and Lin, as Vice Minister of Agriculture, and as Administrator of Beiping.
translations.idiomatic: In office he served in turn as inspector of Song, Shun, and Lin provinces, as Vice Minister of Agriculture, and as administrator of Beiping.

sentences.zh: 從子熾熾字仲光，上党文宣王稚之曾孫也。

translations.literal: His nephew's son Chi—Chi, style name Zhongguang—was a great-grandson of Prince Wenxuan of Shangdang, Zhi.
translations.idiomatic: His nephew's son Chi, style name Zhongguang, was a great-grandson of Prince Wenxuan of Shangdang, Zhi.

sentences.zh: 祖裕，魏太常卿、冀州刺史。

translations.literal: His grandfather Yu was Wei Director of the Ancestral Temple and inspector of Ji province.
translations.idiomatic: His grandfather Yu had been Wei Director of the Ancestral Temple and inspector of Ji province.

sentences.zh: 父兕，周開府儀同三司、熊絳二州刺史、平原侯。

translations.literal: His father Si was Zhou Opener of the Gate with ceremony equal to the Three Excellencies, inspector of the two provinces Xiong and Jiang, and Marquis of Pingyuan.
translations.idiomatic: His father Si had been Zhou Opener of the Gate with ceremony equal to the Three Excellencies, inspector of Xiong and Jiang provinces, and Marquis of Pingyuan.

sentences.zh: 熾性敏慧，美姿儀，頗涉群書，兼長武藝。

translations.literal: Chi was by nature keen and intelligent, handsome in bearing, had considerable acquaintance with many books, and was also accomplished in martial arts.
translations.idiomatic: Chi was quick-witted by nature, handsome in bearing, widely read, and also skilled in martial arts.

sentences.zh: 建德初，武帝尚道法，尤好玄言，求學兼經史、善於談論者，為通道館學士。

translations.literal: At the beginning of the Jiande era Emperor Wu esteemed the Way and its techniques and was especially fond of abstruse discourse; he sought men who studied both the classics and histories and were skilled in discussion, appointing them scholars of the Hall of Universal Passage.
translations.idiomatic: At the start of the Jiande era Emperor Wu favored Daoist practice and especially loved abstruse discourse; he sought men learned in both classics and histories who were skilled debaters and appointed them scholars of the Hall of Universal Passage.

sentences.zh: 熾應其選，與英俊並遊，通涉彌博。

translations.literal: Chi answered the selection, associated and traveled with outstanding talents, and his comprehensive learning grew ever broader.
translations.idiomatic: Chi was chosen for the post, kept company with the court's brightest minds, and broadened his learning still further.

sentences.zh: 建德二年，授雍州倉城令，尋轉盩啡令。

translations.literal: In the second year of Jiande he was appointed magistrate of Cangcheng in Yong province, and soon transferred to be magistrate of Dangyin.
translations.idiomatic: In Jiande year 2 he was appointed magistrate of Cangcheng in Yong province, and soon afterward was transferred to magistrate of Dangyin.

sentences.zh: 頻宰二邑，考績連最，遷崤郡守。

translations.literal: Having repeatedly governed two districts, his performance evaluations were continuously rated highest, and he was promoted to Administrator of Xiao commandery.
translations.idiomatic: After governing two districts in succession with top performance ratings, he was promoted to administrator of Xiao commandery.

sentences.zh: 入為禦正上士。

translations.literal: He entered the capital and became Senior Attendant of the Imperial Rectifier.
translations.idiomatic: He entered the capital and became senior attendant of the Imperial Rectifier.

sentences.zh: 高祖作相，擢為丞相府功曹參軍，加大都督，封陽平縣子，邑二百戶。

translations.literal: When Emperor Gaozu was Chancellor, Chi was promoted to Staff Officer of Merit Records in the Chancellor's Office, was given the additional title of Grand Commander, and was enfeoffed as Viscount of Yangping county with a fief of two hundred households.
translations.idiomatic: When Yang Jian was Chancellor, Chi was promoted to staff officer of merit records in the chancellor's office, given the additional title of Grand Commander, and enfeoffed as Viscount of Yangping with a fief of two hundred households.

sentences.zh: 遷稍伯下大夫。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Junior Grand Master of the Office of the Regional Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to junior grand master of the Office of the Regional Inspector.

sentences.zh: 其年王謙反，熾從信州總管王長述溯江而上。

translations.literal: That year Wang Qian rebelled; Chi followed Xin province area commander Wang Changshu upstream along the Yangzi.
translations.idiomatic: That year Wang Qian rebelled; Chi followed Xin province area commander Wang Changshu up the Yangzi.

sentences.zh: 以熾為前軍，破謙一鎮，定楚、合等五州，擒偽總管荊山西元振，以功拜儀同三司。

translations.literal: Chi was made vanguard; he broke one of Qian's fortified posts, pacified the five provinces Chu, He, and others, captured the false area commander Yuan Zhen of Jingshan West, and for merit was appointed Acting Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: Chi served as vanguard, broke one of Qian's fortified posts, pacified Chu, He, and three other provinces, captured the rebel area commander Yuan Zhen of western Jingshan, and was appointed Acting Three Excellencies for his merit.

sentences.zh: 及高祖受禪，熾率官屬先入清宮，即日授內史舍人、上儀同三司。

translations.literal: When Emperor Gaozu received the abdication, Chi led the officials and staff to enter and secure the palace first; that same day he was appointed Attendant of the Palace Secretariat and Senior Acting Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: When Yang Jian accepted the throne, Chi led the officials into the palace first to secure it; that same day he was appointed attendant of the Palace Secretariat and Senior Acting Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: 尋以本官攝判東宮右庶子，出入兩宮，甚被委遇。

translations.literal: Soon, retaining his original office, he was appointed acting Right Vice President of the Eastern Palace; entering and leaving both palaces, he was greatly entrusted and favored.
translations.idiomatic: Soon, while retaining his original post, he was made acting Right Vice President of the Eastern Palace; moving between both palaces, he enjoyed great trust and favor.

sentences.zh: 加以處事周密，高祖每稱美之。

translations.literal: Moreover, because he handled affairs with thorough care, Emperor Gaozu often praised him.
translations.idiomatic: Because he handled affairs with meticulous care, Emperor Gaozu often praised him.

sentences.zh: 授左領軍長史，持節，使于東南道三十六州，廢置州郡，巡省風俗。

translations.literal: He was appointed Chief Clerk of the Left Army of the Palace Guards, bearing the staff of authority as envoy to the thirty-six provinces of the Southeast Circuit, abolishing and establishing prefectures and commanderies and touring to inspect local customs.
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed chief clerk of the Left Army of the Palace Guards and, bearing the staff of authority, was sent as envoy to the thirty-six provinces of the Southeast Circuit to reorganize prefectures and commanderies and inspect local customs.

sentences.zh: 還授太子僕，加諫議大夫，攝長安令。

translations.literal: On his return he was appointed Master of the Household of the Heir Apparent, with the additional title of Grand Master of Remonstrance, and acted as magistrate of Chang'an.
translations.idiomatic: On his return he was appointed master of the household of the heir apparent, given the additional title of grand master of remonstrance, and served as acting magistrate of Chang'an.

sentences.zh: 與大興令梁毗俱為稱職。

translations.literal: Together with the magistrate of Daxing, Liang Pi, both were regarded as fully competent in office.
translations.idiomatic: He and Liang Pi, magistrate of Daxing, were both regarded as exemplary officials.

sentences.zh: 然毗以嚴正聞，熾以寬平顯，為政不同，部內各化。

translations.literal: Yet Pi was known for severity and rectitude, while Chi was distinguished for leniency and fairness; their governance differed, yet within their jurisdictions each transformed the people in his own way.
translations.idiomatic: Pi was known for severity and rectitude, while Chi was noted for leniency and fairness; though their styles differed, each district was transformed under its magistrate.

sentences.zh: 尋領右常平監，遷雍州贊治，改封饒良縣子。

translations.literal: Soon he took charge of the Right Office of Regular Granaries, was transferred to Assistant Administrator of Yong province, and his enfeoffment was changed to Viscount of Raoliang county.
translations.idiomatic: He soon took charge of the Right Office of Regular Granaries, was transferred to assistant administrator of Yong province, and was re-enfeoffed as Viscount of Raoliang.

sentences.zh: 遷鴻臚少卿。

translations.literal: He was transferred to Vice Director of the Court for Diplomatic Reception.
translations.idiomatic: He was transferred to vice director of the Court for Diplomatic Reception.

sentences.zh: 後數歲，轉太常少卿，進位開府儀同三司。

translations.literal: Several years later he was transferred to Vice Director of the Ancestral Temple and advanced to Opener of the Gate with ceremony equal to the Three Excellencies.
translations.idiomatic: Several years later he became vice director of the Ancestral Temple and was promoted to Opener of the Gate with ceremony equal to the Three Excellencies.

sentences.zh: 複持節為河南道二十八州巡省大使，于路授吏部侍郎。

translations.literal: Again bearing the staff of authority, he served as touring and inspecting envoy to the twenty-eight provinces of the Henan Circuit; en route he was appointed Vice Director of the Ministry of Personnel.
translations.idiomatic: Again bearing the staff of authority, he served as touring envoy to the twenty-eight provinces of the Henan Circuit and was appointed vice director of the Ministry of Personnel en route.

sentences.zh: 大業元年，遷大理卿，複為西南道大使，巡省風俗。

translations.literal: In the first year of Daye he was transferred to Director of the Court of Judicial Review, and again served as envoy of the Southwest Circuit, touring to inspect local customs.
translations.idiomatic: In Daye year 1 he became director of the Court of Judicial Review and again served as envoy of the Southwest Circuit to inspect local customs.

sentences.zh: 擢拜戶部尚書。

translations.literal: He was promoted and appointed Minister of the Household Registers.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to Minister of the Household Registers.

sentences.zh: 吐谷渾寇張掖，令熾率精騎五千擊走之，追至青海而還，以功授銀青光祿大夫。

translations.literal: When the Tuyuhun raided Zhangye, Chi was ordered to lead five thousand elite horsemen to strike and drive them off; he pursued as far as Qinghai and returned, and for merit was granted Silver-Gleaming Grand Master of Splendid Happiness.
translations.idiomatic: When the Tuyuhun raided Zhangye, Chi was ordered to lead five thousand elite cavalry to drive them off; he pursued them to Qinghai and returned, and was granted Silver-Gleaming Grand Master of Splendid Happiness for his service.

sentences.zh: 六年，幸江都宮，留熾于東都居守，仍攝左候衛將軍事。

translations.literal: In the sixth year the emperor visited the Jiangdu Palace; Chi was left at the Eastern Capital to hold garrison duty and also acted in the affairs of Left Commander of the Palace Guards.
translations.idiomatic: In year 6 the emperor visited the Jiangdu Palace; Chi was left at the Eastern Capital to hold the city and also acted as commander of the Left Guards.

sentences.zh: 其年卒官，時年六十二。

translations.literal: That year he died in office, at the age of sixty-two.
translations.idiomatic: He died in office that year, at the age of sixty-two.

sentences.zh: 諡曰靜。

translations.literal: His posthumous title was Jing.
translations.idiomatic: He was given the posthumous title Jing.

sentences.zh: 子安世，通事謁者。

translations.literal: His son Anshi was an Attendant for Diplomatic Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: His son Anshi served as attendant for diplomatic affairs.

sentences.zh: 熾弟晟晟字季晟，性通敏，略涉書記，善彈工射，趫捷過人。

translations.literal: Chi's younger brother Sheng—Sheng, style name Jisheng—was by nature quick and perceptive, had some acquaintance with written records, was skilled at archery and shooting, and in leaping agility surpassed others.
translations.idiomatic: Chi's younger brother Sheng, style name Jisheng, was quick-witted by nature, had some clerical training, was skilled at archery, and was exceptionally agile.

sentences.zh: 時周室尚武，貴遊子弟鹹以相矜，每共馳射，時輩皆出其下。

translations.literal: At the time the Zhou court esteemed martial prowess; sons of the noble and roaming families all prided themselves on one another, and whenever they raced and shot together, their contemporaries all fell below him.
translations.idiomatic: The Zhou court then prized martial prowess, and young nobles vied with one another at riding and archery; in such contests Sheng outclassed all his peers.

sentences.zh: 年十八，為司衛上士。

translations.literal: At the age of eighteen he became Senior Attendant of the Palace Guards.
translations.idiomatic: At eighteen he became senior attendant of the Palace Guards.

sentences.zh: 初未知名，人弗之識也，唯高祖一見，深嗟異焉，乃攜其手而謂人曰：「長孫郎武藝逸群，適與其言，又多奇略。

translations.literal: At first he was not yet known by name and people did not recognize him; only Emperor Gaozu, upon a single meeting, sighed deeply in wonder, took him by the hand, and said to others, "Master Zhangsun's martial arts surpass the multitude; just now in speaking with him I found he also has many extraordinary stratagems."
translations.idiomatic: At first he was unknown, but Emperor Gaozu, upon meeting him once, was deeply impressed; taking him by the hand he said to those present, "This Zhangsun lad's martial skill is beyond the common run; in conversation just now I found he has many extraordinary stratagems as well."

sentences.zh: 後之名將，非此子邪？

translations.literal: The famous generals of later times—will they not be this young man?
translations.idiomatic: Surely the famous generals of the future will be this young man?

sentences.zh: 宣帝時，突厥攝圖請婚于周，以趙王招女妻之。

translations.literal: Under Emperor Xuan the Türk leader Shetu requested marriage with Zhou; the daughter of Prince Zhao, Zhao, was given to him as wife.
translations.idiomatic: Under Emperor Xuan the Türk leader Shetu sought a marriage alliance with Zhou, and the daughter of Prince Zhao was given to him in marriage.

sentences.zh: 然周與攝圖各相誇競，妙選驍勇以充使者，因遣晟副汝南公宇文神慶送千金公主至其牙。

translations.literal: Yet Zhou and Shetu each strove to outdo the other; the finest brave warriors were selected to serve as envoys, and Sheng was therefore dispatched as deputy to the Duke of Runan, Yuwen Shenqing, to escort the Princess of a Thousand Gold to his royal camp.
translations.idiomatic: Zhou and Shetu each sought to outshine the other, so the bravest men were chosen as envoys; Sheng was sent as deputy to Duke Yuwen Shenqing of Runan to escort the Princess of a Thousand Gold to the Türk royal camp.

sentences.zh: 前後使人數十輩，攝圖多不禮，見晟而獨愛焉，每共遊獵，留之竟歲。

translations.literal: Before and after, envoys numbered in dozens of parties; Shetu for the most part showed them no courtesy, yet upon seeing Sheng he alone favored him, and they often hunted together; he detained him for a full year.
translations.idiomatic: Dozens of envoys had come before and after, and Shetu had usually treated them discourteously, but he took a special liking to Sheng, hunted with him often, and kept him for a full year.

sentences.zh: 嘗有二雕，飛而爭肉，因以兩箭與晟曰：「請射取之。

translations.literal: Once there were two eagles flying and contending over meat; he therefore gave Sheng two arrows and said, "Please shoot and take them."
translations.idiomatic: Once two eagles were fighting in the air over a piece of meat; Shetu handed Sheng two arrows and said, "Shoot them down for me."

sentences.zh: 」晟乃彎弓馳往，遇雕相攫，遂一發而雙貫焉。

translations.literal: " Sheng then bent his bow and galloped toward them; when he met the eagles seizing one another, with a single shot he pierced them both.
translations.idiomatic: " Sheng bent his bow and galloped toward them; as the eagles grappled with each other he loosed one arrow and transfixed them both.

sentences.zh: 攝圖喜，命諸子弟貴人皆相親友，冀昵近之，以學彈射。

translations.literal: Shetu was pleased and ordered all his sons, younger brothers, and nobles to befriend one another with him, hoping to draw close to him and learn archery and shooting.
translations.idiomatic: Shetu was delighted and ordered all his sons, younger kinsmen, and nobles to befriend Sheng, hoping to draw close to him and learn archery.

sentences.zh: 其弟處羅侯號突利設，尤得眾心。

translations.literal: His younger brother Chulühou, titled Tuli shad, especially won the hearts of the people.
translations.idiomatic: His younger brother Chulühou, titled Tuli shad, was especially popular among the tribes.

sentences.zh: 而為攝圖所忌，密托心腹，陰與晟盟。

translations.literal: Yet he was envied by Shetu; he secretly entrusted his intimate followers and covertly formed an alliance with Sheng.
translations.idiomatic: Shetu envied him, however; he secretly entrusted his closest followers and formed a covert alliance with Sheng.

sentences.zh: 晟與之遊獵，因察山川形勢，部眾強弱，皆盡知之。

translations.literal: Sheng hunted with him and thereby observed the terrain and mountain passes, the strength and weakness of the tribal forces—he came to know them all thoroughly.
translations.idiomatic: While hunting with him, Sheng surveyed the terrain and assessed the strength of each tribal faction until he knew them all thoroughly.

sentences.zh: 時高祖作相，晟以狀白高祖。

translations.literal: At the time Emperor Gaozu was Chancellor; Sheng reported the situation to Emperor Gaozu.
translations.idiomatic: When Yang Jian was Chancellor, Sheng reported what he had learned to him.

sentences.zh: 高祖大喜，遷奉車都尉。

translations.literal: Emperor Gaozu was greatly pleased and promoted him to Commandant of the Imperial Carriages.
translations.idiomatic: Yang Jian was greatly pleased and promoted him to commandant of the imperial carriages.

sentences.zh: 至開皇元年，攝圖曰：「我周家親也，今隋公自立而不能制，複何面目見可賀敦乎」？

translations.literal: By the first year of Kaihuang, Shetu said, "I am kin of the Zhou house; now the Duke of Sui has set himself up and I cannot control him—what face have I to show Kehedun?"
translations.idiomatic: In Kaihuang year 1 Shetu said, "I am kin to the Zhou house; now the Duke of Sui has proclaimed himself and I cannot restrain him—how can I face Kehedun?"

sentences.zh: 因與高寶寧攻陷臨渝鎮，約諸面部落謀共南侵。

translations.literal: He thereupon joined with Gao Baoning in capturing Linyu post, and arranged with the various tribal chiefs to plot a joint southern invasion.
translations.idiomatic: He then joined Gao Baoning in capturing Linyu post and conspired with the tribal chiefs for a joint invasion of the south.

sentences.zh: 高祖新立，由是大懼，修築長城，發兵屯北境，命陰壽鎮幽州，虞慶則鎮并州，屯兵數萬人以為之備。

translations.literal: Emperor Gaozu had newly taken the throne and on this account was greatly afraid; he repaired the Long Wall, dispatched troops to garrison the northern frontier, ordered Yin Shou to hold You province and Yu Qingze to hold Bing province, and stationed tens of thousands of soldiers as preparation.
translations.idiomatic: The newly enthroned emperor was deeply alarmed; he repaired the Great Wall, sent troops to garrison the northern frontier, placed Yin Shou at You province and Yu Qingze at Bing province, and stationed tens of thousands of men in readiness.

sentences.zh: 晟先知攝圖、玷厥、阿波、突利等叔侄兄弟各統強兵，俱號可汗，分居四面，內懷猜忌，外示和同，難以力征，易可離間，因上書曰：「臣聞喪亂之極，必致升平，是故上天啟其機，聖人成其務。

translations.literal: Sheng had long known that Shetu, Dianjue, Apo, Tuli, and other uncles, nephews, and brothers each commanded strong armies, all styled themselves khaghans, and dwelt on the four sides; inwardly they harbored suspicion, outwardly they displayed harmony—it would be hard to conquer them by force, yet easy to set them at odds. He therefore submitted a memorial saying, "Your servant has heard that the extreme of disorder and ruin must lead to the ascent of peace; therefore Heaven opens the opportunity and the sage completes the task."
translations.idiomatic: Sheng had long known that Shetu, Dianjue, Apo, Tuli, and their kinsmen each commanded strong forces, all styled themselves khaghans, and held the four quarters; inwardly suspicious yet outwardly united, they could not easily be conquered by force but could readily be set against one another. He therefore submitted a memorial: "I have heard that the depths of chaos must give way to peace; Heaven opens the opportunity, and the sage completes the work."

sentences.zh: 伏惟皇帝陛下當百王之末，膺千載之期，諸夏雖安，戎場尚梗，興師致討，未是其時，棄於度外，又複侵擾。

translations.literal: I humbly consider that Your Majesty stands at the end of the hundred kings and has received the term of a thousand years; though the various Xia domains are at peace, the barbarian frontier is still obstructed; to raise armies and launch punitive campaigns is not yet the time, yet if cast beyond reckoning they will again raid and harass.
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty stands at the end of an age of kings and has received a mandate for a new era; though the central domains are at peace, the frontier remains troubled; to raise armies for punitive campaigns is not yet timely, yet if left unchecked the barbarians will raid again.

sentences.zh: 故宜密運籌策，漸以攘之，計失則百姓不甯，計得則萬代之福。

translations.literal: Therefore one should secretly deploy stratagems and gradually displace them; if the plan fails the common people will not be at peace, but if the plan succeeds it will be a blessing for ten thousand generations.
translations.idiomatic: Secret stratagems should therefore be deployed to wear them down gradually; if the plan fails the people will know no peace, but if it succeeds it will secure blessings for ages to come.

sentences.zh: 吉凶所系，伏願詳思。

translations.literal: Fortune and misfortune depend upon this; I humbly beg that Your Majesty reflect upon it carefully.
translations.idiomatic: Fortune and disaster hang upon this; I humbly beg Your Majesty to consider it carefully.

sentences.zh: 臣於週末，忝充外使，匈奴倚伏，實所具知。

translations.literal: Your servant, at the end of Zhou, was honored to serve as an envoy abroad; the rises and falls of the Xiongnu I truly know in full detail.
translations.idiomatic: At the end of Zhou I had the honor of serving as an envoy abroad and came to know the Xiongnu factions and their shifting fortunes in full detail.

sentences.zh: 玷厥之於攝圖，兵強而位下，外名相屬，內隙已彰，鼓動其情，必將自戰。

translations.literal: As for Dianjue in relation to Shetu, his troops are strong yet his rank is low; outwardly they are nominally subordinate, yet inwardly their rift is already manifest—if his feelings are stirred, they will surely fight one another.
translations.idiomatic: Dianjue's forces are strong but his rank is subordinate to Shetu's; though nominally subject to him, their rift is already clear—stir his resentment and they will surely fight each other.

sentences.zh: 又處羅侯者，攝圖之弟，奸多而勢弱，曲取於眾心，國人愛之，因為攝圖所忌，其心殊不自安，跡示彌縫，實懷疑懼。

translations.literal: Moreover Chulühou is Shetu's younger brother—cunning in many ways yet weak in power; he bends to win popular hearts and the people of the state love him, and therefore is envied by Shetu; his heart is especially ill at ease; outwardly he shows conciliation, yet inwardly he harbors suspicion and fear.
translations.idiomatic: Chulühou, Shetu's younger brother, is cunning but weak in power; he curries favor with the tribes and is beloved by them, and Shetu envies him for it; though outwardly conciliatory, he is inwardly uneasy and afraid.

sentences.zh: 又阿波首鼠，介在其間，頗畏攝圖，受其牽率，唯強是與，未有定心。

translations.literal: Moreover Apo is irresolute, standing between them; he greatly fears Shetu, is drawn along by him, and follows whichever side is strong—he has no settled mind.
translations.idiomatic: Apo, meanwhile, wavers between them; he fears Shetu, follows his lead, and sides with whichever faction is stronger—his loyalty is unsettled.

sentences.zh: 今宜遠交而近攻，離強而合弱，通使玷厥，說合阿波，則攝圖回兵，自防右地。

translations.literal: Now one should befriend those far and attack those near, separate the strong and unite the weak, send envoys to Dianjue and win Apo by persuasion—then Shetu will turn back his troops to defend his western domains himself.
translations.idiomatic: We should befriend the distant and strike at the near, divide the strong and unite the weak, send envoys to Dianjue and win Apo over—then Shetu will have to turn his armies back to defend his western domains.

sentences.zh: 又引處羅，遣連奚、霫，則攝圖分眾，還備左方。

translations.literal: Further, draw in Chulühou and send to ally with the Xi and Mohe—then Shetu will divide his forces and turn back to guard his eastern flank.
translations.idiomatic: Further, draw in Chulühou and ally with the Xi and Mohe tribes—then Shetu will have to divide his forces and guard his eastern flank.

sentences.zh: 首尾猜嫌，腹心離阻，十數年後，承釁討之，必可一舉而空其國矣。

translations.literal: With suspicion at head and tail and estrangement at the core, after a dozen years or so, seizing the opportunity to launch punitive action, one will surely be able in a single stroke to empty their state.
translations.idiomatic: Once suspicion divides head from tail and the center falls apart, a punitive campaign launched a dozen years hence will surely empty their state in a single stroke.

sentences.zh: 」上省表大悅，因召與語。

translations.literal: " The emperor, upon reviewing the memorial, was greatly pleased and therefore summoned him to speak.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor was greatly pleased when he read the memorial and summoned Sheng to discuss it.

sentences.zh: 晟複口陳形勢，手畫山川，寫其虛實，皆如指掌。

translations.literal: Sheng again set forth the situation orally and with his hand drew the mountains and rivers, setting down their strengths and weaknesses—all as clear as the lines on one's palm.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng again described the situation orally and sketched the terrain with his hand, laying out each faction's strengths and weaknesses as clearly as lines on his palm.

sentences.zh: 上深嗟異，皆納用焉。

translations.literal: The emperor sighed deeply in wonder and adopted all of it.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor marveled and adopted every recommendation.

sentences.zh: 因遣太僕元暉出伊吾道，使詣玷厥，賜以狼頭纛，謬為欽敬，禮數甚優。

translations.literal: He therefore dispatched the Master of the Stud Yuan Hui by the Yiwu route as envoy to Dianjue, bestowing upon him a wolf-head banner, feigning deep respect, with ceremonial honors very generous.
translations.idiomatic: He therefore sent Master of the Stud Yuan Hui by the Yiwu route as envoy to Dianjue, bestowing a wolf-head banner and treating him with elaborate courtesy while feigning deep respect.

sentences.zh: 玷厥使來，引居攝圖使上。

translations.literal: When Dianjue's envoy came, he was seated above Shetu's envoy.
translations.idiomatic: When Dianjue's envoy arrived, he was seated above Shetu's envoy.

sentences.zh: 反間既行，果相猜貳。

translations.literal: Once the stratagem of alienation had been carried out, they indeed became mutually suspicious and divided.
translations.idiomatic: Once the stratagem of alienation took effect, the Türk factions indeed turned suspicious and divided against one another.

sentences.zh: 授晟車騎將軍，出黃龍道，齎幣賜奚、霫、契丹等，遣為嚮導，得至處羅侯所，深布心腹，誘令內附。

translations.literal: Sheng was appointed Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry, sent out by the Yellow Dragon route bearing gifts to bestow upon the Xi, Mohe, Khitan, and others; they were dispatched as guides, enabling him to reach Chulühou's camp, where he deeply planted trusted agents and induced submission to the interior.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng was appointed Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry and sent out by the Yellow Dragon route with gifts for the Xi, Mohe, Khitan, and others; using them as guides he reached Chulühou's camp, won his confidence, and induced him to submit.

sentences.zh: 二年，攝圖四十萬騎自蘭州入，至於周盤，破達奚長儒軍，更欲南入。

translations.literal: In the second year Shetu led four hundred thousand horsemen in from Lanzhou as far as Zhoupan, defeated the army of Daxi Changru, and wished to press farther south.
translations.idiomatic: In year 2 Shetu led four hundred thousand cavalry in from Lanzhou to Zhoupan, defeated Daxi Changru's army, and prepared to drive farther south.

sentences.zh: 玷厥不從，引兵而去。

translations.literal: Dianjue would not follow and led his troops away.
translations.idiomatic: Dianjue refused to follow and withdrew with his troops.

sentences.zh: 時晟又說染幹詐告攝圖曰：「鐵勒等反，欲襲其牙。

translations.literal: At that time Sheng also persuaded Tuli to send a false report to Shetu saying, "The Tiele and others have rebelled and wish to strike your royal camp."
translations.idiomatic: Sheng also persuaded Tuli to send Shetu a false report that the Tiele had rebelled and were about to attack his royal camp.

sentences.zh: 」攝圖乃懼，回兵出塞。

translations.literal: " Shetu thereupon grew afraid and turned his army back beyond the frontier.
translations.idiomatic: " Shetu was alarmed and withdrew his army beyond the frontier.

sentences.zh: 後數月，突厥大入，發八道元帥分出拒之。

translations.literal: Several months later the Türks invaded on a large scale; eight circuit campaign commanders were dispatched separately to resist them.
translations.idiomatic: Several months later the Türks invaded in force, and eight circuit campaign commanders were dispatched to meet them.

sentences.zh: 阿波至涼州，與竇榮定戰，賊帥累北。

translations.literal: Apo reached Liangzhou and fought with Dou Rongding; the enemy leader was repeatedly driven north.
translations.idiomatic: Apo reached Liangzhou and fought Dou Rongding, and the enemy leader was repeatedly driven back.

sentences.zh: 時晟為偏將，使謂之曰：「攝圖每來，戰皆大勝。

translations.literal: At the time Sheng was a subordinate general and sent someone to say to him, "Whenever Shetu comes, his battles are all great victories."
translations.idiomatic: Sheng, then a subordinate general, sent a messenger to tell Apo, "Whenever Shetu campaigns, he wins great victories."

sentences.zh: 阿波才入，便即致敗，此乃突厥之恥，豈不內愧於心乎？

translations.literal: Apo has only just entered and has already suffered defeat—this is a disgrace to the Türks; will you not feel inward shame in your heart?
translations.idiomatic: You have only just arrived and already been defeated—this is a disgrace to the Türks. Can you not feel ashamed at heart?

sentences.zh: 且攝圖之與阿波，兵勢本敵。

translations.literal: Moreover, as between Shetu and Apo, their military strength was originally matched as rivals.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, Shetu and Apo were originally military equals.

sentences.zh: 今攝圖日勝，為眾所崇，阿波不利，為國生辱。

translations.literal: Now Shetu wins day by day and is honored by the masses, while Apo fares ill and brings shame upon the state.
translations.idiomatic: Now Shetu wins victory after victory and is honored by the tribes, while your setbacks bring shame upon the Türk state.

sentences.zh: 攝圖必當因以罪歸於阿波，成其夙計，滅北牙矣。

translations.literal: Shetu will surely use this to lay the blame upon Apo, fulfill his long-standing plan, and destroy the Northern Court.
translations.idiomatic: Shetu will surely shift the blame onto you, fulfill his long-standing plan, and destroy the Northern Court.

sentences.zh: 願自量度，能禦之乎？

translations.literal: I beg you to measure yourself—can you withstand him?
translations.idiomatic: Consider for yourself—can you withstand him?

sentences.zh: 」阿波使至，晟又謂之曰：「今達頭與隋連和，而攝圖不能制。

translations.literal: " When Apo's envoy arrived, Sheng again said to him, "Now Tardu has allied with Sui, yet Shetu cannot control him."
translations.idiomatic: " When Apo's envoy arrived, Sheng told him further, "Tardu has now allied with Sui, and Shetu cannot control him."

sentences.zh: 可汗何不依附天子，連結達頭，相合為強，此萬全之計。

translations.literal: Why does the khan not attach himself to the Son of Heaven, link with Tardu, and join strengths—this is a plan of complete security.
translations.idiomatic: Why not attach yourself to the Son of Heaven and join with Tardu to grow strong together? That would be a plan of complete security.

sentences.zh: 豈若喪兵負罪，歸就攝圖，受其戮辱邪？

translations.literal: How could that compare with losing troops, bearing guilt, returning to Shetu, and suffering his slaughter and humiliation?
translations.idiomatic: Surely that is better than losing your army, bearing guilt, returning to Shetu, and suffering his slaughter and humiliation?

sentences.zh: 」阿波納之，因留塞上，使人隨晟入朝。

translations.literal: " Apo accepted this, therefore remained on the frontier, and sent someone to follow Sheng into court.
translations.idiomatic: " Apo accepted the advice, remained on the frontier, and sent an envoy to follow Sheng to court.

sentences.zh: 時攝圖與衛王軍遇，戰于白道，敗走至磧。

translations.literal: At that time Shetu encountered the army of the Prince of Wei and fought at Baidao; defeated, he fled to the desert.
translations.idiomatic: Shetu then met the army of the Prince of Wei at Baidao, was defeated, and fled into the desert.

sentences.zh: 聞阿波懷貳，乃掩北牙，盡獲其眾而殺其母。

translations.literal: Hearing that Apo harbored disloyalty, he then raided the Northern Court, seized all his followers, and killed his mother.
translations.idiomatic: Learning that Apo was disloyal, he raided the Northern Court, seized all his followers, and killed Apo's mother.

sentences.zh: 阿波還無所歸，西奔玷厥，乞師十余萬，東擊攝圖，複得故地，收散卒數萬，與攝圖相攻。

translations.literal: Apo returned with nowhere to go, fled west to Dianjue, and begged for more than a hundred thousand troops; he struck east against Shetu, recovered his former territory, gathered several tens of thousands of scattered soldiers, and fought Shetu back and forth.
translations.idiomatic: Apo had nowhere to turn, fled west to Dianjue, and borrowed more than a hundred thousand troops; marching east against Shetu he recovered his old territory, rallied tens of thousands of scattered soldiers, and fought Shetu back and forth.

sentences.zh: 阿波頻勝，其勢益張。

translations.literal: Apo won repeatedly and his power grew ever greater.
translations.idiomatic: Apo won repeatedly and his power grew steadily.

sentences.zh: 攝圖又遣使朝貢，公主自請改姓，乞為帝女，上許之。

translations.literal: Shetu again sent envoys with tribute; the princess herself requested to change her surname and begged to become the emperor's daughter, and the emperor granted it.
translations.idiomatic: Shetu again sent tribute envoys; the princess asked to change her surname and become the emperor's daughter, and the emperor agreed.

sentences.zh: 四年，遣晟副虞慶則使於攝圖，賜公主姓為楊氏，改封大義公主。

translations.literal: In the fourth year Sheng was dispatched as deputy to Yu Qingze on a mission to Shetu; the princess was granted the surname Yang and her enfeoffment was changed to Princess Dayi.
translations.idiomatic: In year 4 Sheng accompanied Yu Qingze on a mission to Shetu; the princess was given the surname Yang and re-enfeoffed as Princess Dayi.

sentences.zh: 攝圖奉詔，不肯起拜，晟進曰：「突厥與隋俱是大國天子，可汗不起，安敢違意。

translations.literal: Shetu received the imperial decree but refused to rise and bow; Sheng stepped forward and said, "Türks and Sui are both great states with Sons of Heaven; if the khan does not rise, how would I dare go against his intent?"
translations.idiomatic: Shetu received the decree but refused to rise and bow; Sheng stepped forward and said, "The Türks and Sui are both great powers with Sons of Heaven; if the khan does not rise, how dare I go against his wishes?"

sentences.zh: 但可賀敦為帝女，則可汗是大隋女婿，奈何無禮，不敬婦公乎？

translations.literal: Yet since Kehedun is the emperor's daughter, the khan is the Great Sui's son-in-law—how can he be without courtesy and fail to respect his wife's father?
translations.idiomatic: But Kehedun is the emperor's daughter, so the khan is Great Sui's son-in-law—how can he be discourteous and fail to respect his father-in-law?

sentences.zh: 」攝圖乃笑謂其達官曰：「須拜婦公，我從之耳。

translations.literal: " Shetu then laughed and said to his high officials, "I must bow to my father-in-law; I shall follow this."
translations.idiomatic: " Shetu laughed and told his high officials, "I must bow to my father-in-law—I shall do as he says."

sentences.zh: 」於是乃拜詔書。

translations.literal: " He thereupon bowed to the edict.
translations.idiomatic: " He thereupon bowed to the edict.

sentences.zh: 使還稱旨，授儀同三司、左勳衛車騎將軍。

translations.literal: When the envoy returned and reported that he had fulfilled the imperial intent, Sheng was appointed Acting Three Excellencies and Grand General of Chariots and Cavalry of the Left Merit Guard.
translations.idiomatic: When the mission returned with a favorable report, Sheng was appointed Acting Three Excellencies and grand general of chariots and cavalry of the Left Merit Guard.

sentences.zh: 七年，攝圖死，遣晟持節拜其弟處羅侯為莫何可汗，以其子雍閭為葉護可汗。

translations.literal: In the seventh year Shetu died; Sheng was sent bearing the staff of authority to invest his younger brother Chulühou as Mohé khaghan and his son Yunglu as yabghu khaghan.
translations.idiomatic: In year 7 Shetu died; Sheng was sent with the staff of authority to invest his younger brother Chulühou as Mohé khaghan and his son Yunglu as yabghu khaghan.

sentences.zh: 處羅侯因晟奏曰：「阿波為天所滅，與五六千騎在山谷間，伏聽詔旨，當取之以獻。

translations.literal: Chulühou, through Sheng, memorialized saying, "Apo has been destroyed by Heaven; with five or six thousand horsemen he lies hidden in the valleys, awaiting the imperial decree—I shall take him and present him as tribute."
translations.idiomatic: Through Sheng, Chulühou reported, "Heaven has destroyed Apo; he lies hidden in the valleys with five or six thousand horsemen awaiting your decree—I shall seize him and present him to you."

sentences.zh: 」乃召文武議焉。

translations.literal: " The emperor thereupon summoned civil and military officials to deliberate.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor summoned his civil and military officials to deliberate.

sentences.zh: 樂安西元諧曰：「請就彼梟首，以懲其惡。

translations.literal: Yuan Xie of Xi in Le'an said, "I request that his head be taken there and displayed to punish his wickedness."
translations.idiomatic: Yuan Xie of Xi in Le'an said, "Let his head be taken there and displayed to punish his crimes."

sentences.zh: 」武陽公李充曰：「請生將入朝，顯戮以示百姓。

translations.literal: " Duke Li Chong of Wuyang said, "I request that he be brought alive to court and publicly executed to show the common people."
translations.idiomatic: " Duke Li Chong of Wuyang said, "Bring him alive to court and execute him publicly as an example to the people."

sentences.zh: 」上謂晟曰：「於卿何如？

translations.literal: " The emperor said to Sheng, "What do you think of this?"
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor asked Sheng, "What do you think?"

sentences.zh: 」晟對曰：「若突厥背誕，須齊之以刑。

translations.literal: " Sheng replied, "If the Türks turn their backs in treachery, they must be brought into alignment by punishment."
translations.idiomatic: " Sheng replied, "If the Türks turn treacherous, they must be punished."

sentences.zh: 今其昆弟自相夷滅，阿波之惡，非負國家，因其困窮，取而為戮，恐非招遠之道，不如兩存之。

translations.literal: Now their brothers are destroying one another; Apo's wickedness is not a betrayal of our state—if we seize him in his destitution and put him to death, I fear that is not the way to draw the distant near; it would be better to let both survive.
translations.idiomatic: Now their brothers are destroying one another; Apo's crimes are not against our state—if we seize him in his distress and execute him, I fear that is not how to win over distant peoples; it would be better to let both survive.

sentences.zh: 」上曰：「善。

translations.literal: " The emperor said, "Good."
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor said, "Good."

sentences.zh: 」八年，處羅侯死，遣晟往吊，仍齎陳國所獻寶器以賜雍閭。

translations.literal: In the eighth year Chulühou died; Sheng was sent to offer condolences and also bore the precious vessels presented by Chen to bestow upon Yunglu.
translations.idiomatic: In year 8 Chulühou died; Sheng was sent to offer condolences and also brought the precious vessels Chen had presented to bestow upon Yunglu.

sentences.zh: 十三年，流人楊欽亡入突厥，詐言彭公劉昶共宇文氏女謀欲反隋，稱遣其來，密告主。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year the exile Yang Qin fled into the Türks and falsely claimed that Duke Liu Chang of Peng, together with a daughter of the Yuwen clan, were plotting to rebel against Sui, saying they had sent him to report secretly to their lord.
translations.idiomatic: In year 13 the exile Yang Qin fled to the Türks and falsely claimed that Duke Liu Chang of Peng and a Yuwen clanswoman were plotting rebellion against Sui and had sent him to report secretly to the khaghan.

sentences.zh: 雍閭信之，乃不修職貢。

translations.literal: Yunglu believed him and therefore ceased maintaining tribute duties.
translations.idiomatic: Yunglu believed him and stopped sending tribute.

sentences.zh: 又遣晟出使，微觀察焉。

translations.literal: The emperor again dispatched Sheng on a mission to observe matters discreetly.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor again sent Sheng on a mission to observe the situation discreetly.

sentences.zh: 公主見晟，乃言辭不遜，又遣所私胡人安遂迦共欽計議，扇惑雍閭。

translations.literal: When the princess saw Sheng, her words were insubordinate; she also sent her private Hu retainer Ansuijia to plot with Qin and incite Yunglu.
translations.idiomatic: When the princess saw Sheng she spoke insolently; she also sent her private Hu retainer Ansuijia to plot with Qin and stir up Yunglu.

sentences.zh: 晟至京師，具以狀奏。

translations.literal: When Sheng reached the capital he memorialized the full situation.
translations.idiomatic: When Sheng reached the capital he reported the full situation to the throne.

sentences.zh: 又遣晟往索欽，雍閭欲勿與，謬答曰：「檢校客內，無此色人。

translations.literal: The emperor again sent Sheng to demand Qin; Yunglu wished not to hand him over and falsely replied, "Upon checking among the guests, there is no person of this appearance."
translations.idiomatic: The emperor again sent Sheng to demand Qin; Yunglu wished to refuse and falsely replied, "I have checked among my guests and there is no such person."

sentences.zh: 」晟乃貨其達官，知欽所在，夜掩獲之，以示雍閭，因發公主私事，國人大恥。

translations.literal: " Sheng then bribed his high officials, learned where Qin was, seized him in a night raid, and showed him to Yunglu; he thereby exposed the princess's private affairs, and the people of the state were greatly shamed.
translations.idiomatic: " Sheng bribed Yunglu's high officials, learned Qin's whereabouts, seized him in a night raid, and presented him to Yunglu; he thereby exposed the princess's private affairs, and the Türks were deeply shamed.

sentences.zh: 雍閭執遂迦等，並以付晟。

translations.literal: Yunglu arrested Suijia and the others and handed them all over to Sheng.
translations.idiomatic: Yunglu arrested Suijia and the others and handed them all over to Sheng.

sentences.zh: 上大喜，加授開府，仍遣入籓，蒞殺大義公主。

translations.literal: The emperor was greatly pleased, gave him the additional appointment of Opener of the Gate, and again sent him into the frontier to preside over the execution of Princess Dayi.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was greatly pleased, gave him the additional title of Opener of the Gate, and again sent him to the frontier to preside over the execution of Princess Dayi.

sentences.zh: 雍閭又表請婚，僉議將許之。

translations.literal: Yunglu again submitted a memorial requesting marriage; the collective deliberation was about to grant it.
translations.idiomatic: Yunglu again petitioned for a marriage alliance, and the court was about to approve it.

sentences.zh: 晟又奏曰：「臣觀雍閭，反覆無信，特共玷厥有隙，所以依倚國家。

translations.literal: Sheng again memorialized saying, "Your servant observes that Yunglu is fickle and untrustworthy; he relies upon our state only because he has a rift with Dianjue."
translations.idiomatic: Sheng memorialized again, "I observe that Yunglu is fickle and untrustworthy; he relies on our state only because he is at odds with Dianjue."

sentences.zh: 縱與為婚，終當必叛。

translations.literal: Even if we grant him marriage, in the end he will surely rebel.
translations.idiomatic: Even if we grant him a marriage alliance, he will surely rebel in the end.

sentences.zh: 今若得尚公主，承藉威靈，玷厥、染幹必又受其徵發。

translations.literal: If he now obtains an imperial princess in marriage and borrows her august authority, Dianjue and Tuli will surely again be subject to his summons for campaigns.
translations.idiomatic: If he now marries an imperial princess and borrows her prestige, Dianjue and Tuli will surely again be subject to his military summons.

sentences.zh: 強而更反，後恐難圖。

translations.literal: Once strong he will turn against us again—later he may be hard to deal with.
translations.idiomatic: Once strengthened he will turn against us again, and he may later prove hard to control.

sentences.zh: 且染幹者，處羅侯之子也，素有誠款，於今兩代。

translations.literal: Moreover Tuli is the son of Chulühou and has long shown sincere devotion, now for two generations.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover Tuli is Chulühou's son and has shown sincere loyalty for two generations now.

sentences.zh: 臣前與相見，亦乞通婚，不如許之，招令南徙，兵少力弱，易可撫馴，使敵雍閭，以為邊捍。

translations.literal: When your servant met him before, he too begged for marriage; it would be better to grant it, summon him to move south—his troops are few and his power weak, easily pacified and tamed—and set him against Yunglu as a frontier bulwark.
translations.idiomatic: When I met him before he too asked for a marriage alliance; we should grant it, summon him to move south—his forces are few and weak and easily managed—and set him against Yunglu as a frontier shield.

sentences.zh: 」上曰：「善。

translations.literal: " The emperor said, "Good."
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor said, "Good."

sentences.zh: 」又遣慰喻染幹，許尚公主。

translations.literal: The emperor again sent envoys to comfort and instruct Tuli and promised him an imperial princess in marriage.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor again sent envoys to reassure Tuli and promised him an imperial princess in marriage.

sentences.zh: 十七年，染幹遣五百騎隨晟來逆女，以宗女封安義公主以妻之。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year Tuli sent five hundred horsemen to accompany Sheng in welcoming the bride; an imperial clanswoman was enfeoffed as Princess Anyi and given to him as wife.
translations.idiomatic: In year 17 Tuli sent five hundred horsemen with Sheng to welcome the bride; an imperial clanswoman was enfeoffed as Princess Anyi and given to him in marriage.

sentences.zh: 晟說染幹率眾南徙，居度斤舊鎮。

translations.literal: Sheng persuaded Tuli to lead his people south and settle at the old site of Dujin.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng persuaded Tuli to lead his people south and settle at the old site of Dujin.

sentences.zh: 雍閭疾之，亟來抄略。

translations.literal: Yunglu resented this and repeatedly came to raid and plunder.
translations.idiomatic: Yunglu resented this and repeatedly raided him.

sentences.zh: 染幹伺知動靜，輒遣奏聞，是以賊來每先有備。

translations.literal: Tuli watched and learned of movements and promptly sent reports to court; therefore whenever enemies came he was always prepared beforehand.
translations.idiomatic: Tuli kept watch on enemy movements and promptly reported to court, so whenever raiders came he was always prepared.

sentences.zh: 十九年，染幹因晟奏，雍閭作攻具，欲打大同城。

translations.literal: In the nineteenth year Tuli, through Sheng, memorialized that Yunglu was making siege engines and intended to attack Datong city.
translations.idiomatic: In year 19 Tuli reported through Sheng that Yunglu was building siege engines and intended to attack Datong.

sentences.zh: 詔發六總管，並取漢王節度，分道出塞討之。

translations.literal: An edict ordered six area commanders mobilized, all under the command of the Prince of Han, to advance beyond the frontier by separate routes and punish him.
translations.idiomatic: An edict mobilized six area commanders under the Prince of Han to advance beyond the frontier by separate routes and punish him.

sentences.zh: 雍閭大懼，複共達頭同盟，合力掩襲染幹，大戰于長城下。

translations.literal: Yunglu was greatly afraid, again allied with Tardu, and together launched a surprise attack on Tuli; they fought a great battle below the Long Wall.
translations.idiomatic: Yunglu was greatly alarmed, renewed his alliance with Tardu, and together launched a surprise attack on Tuli; they fought a great battle below the Great Wall.

sentences.zh: 染幹敗績，殺其兄弟子侄，而部落亡散。

translations.literal: Tuli was defeated; his brothers, sons, and nephews were killed, and his tribes scattered and fled.
translations.idiomatic: Tuli was defeated; his brothers, sons, and nephews were killed and his tribes scattered.

sentences.zh: 染幹與晟獨以五騎逼夜南走，至旦，行百餘裡，收得數百騎，乃相與謀曰：「今兵敗入朝，一降人耳，大隋天子豈禮我乎？

translations.literal: Tuli and Sheng alone, with five horsemen, fled south through the night; by dawn they had traveled more than a hundred li and gathered several hundred horsemen; they then consulted together, saying, "Now that our army is defeated, if we enter court we are but surrendered men—will the Son of Heaven of Great Sui treat us with ceremony?"
translations.idiomatic: Tuli and Sheng fled south through the night with only five horsemen; by dawn they had ridden more than a hundred li and rallied several hundred riders; they then said to one another, "Now that we are defeated, if we enter court we are merely surrendered men—will the Son of Heaven of Great Sui honor us?"

sentences.zh: 玷厥雖來，本無冤隙，若往投之，必相存濟。

translations.literal: Although Dianjue is an enemy, we originally have no private grievance; if we go and submit to him, he will surely preserve and aid us.
translations.idiomatic: Though Dianjue is our enemy, we have no private grievance with him; if we submit to him, he will surely shelter us.

sentences.zh: 」晟知其懷貳，乃密遣從者入伏遠鎮，令速舉烽。

translations.literal: " Sheng knew he harbored disloyalty and secretly sent a follower into Fuyuan post to order that beacon fires be raised quickly.
translations.idiomatic: " Sheng knew he was wavering and secretly sent a follower into Fuyuan post to order the beacon fires lit at once.

sentences.zh: 染幹見四烽俱發，問晟曰：「城上然烽何也？

translations.literal: When Tuli saw all four beacons blaze, he asked Sheng, "Why are beacon fires lit atop the wall?"
translations.idiomatic: When Tuli saw all four beacons blaze, he asked Sheng, "Why are the beacon fires lit on the wall?"

sentences.zh: 」晟紿之曰：「城高地迥，必遙見賊來。

translations.literal: " Sheng deceived him, saying, "The wall is high and the ground distant—they must have seen the enemy coming from afar."
translations.idiomatic: " Sheng deceived him, saying, "The post is high and commands a wide view—they must have seen the enemy coming from far off."

sentences.zh: 我國家法，若賊少舉二烽，來多舉三烽，大逼舉四烽，使見賊多而又近耳。

translations.literal: By our state's law, if the enemy are few they raise two beacons; if many come they raise three; if a great pressing force, four—showing that the enemy are numerous and also near.
translations.idiomatic: By our law, two beacons mean few enemies, three mean many, and four mean a large force close at hand.

sentences.zh: 」染幹大懼，謂其眾曰：「追兵已逼，且可投城。

translations.literal: " Tuli was greatly afraid and said to his followers, "Pursuing troops are already pressing close—we had better take refuge in the city."
translations.idiomatic: " Tuli was greatly alarmed and told his followers, "The pursuers are close—we had better take refuge in the city."

sentences.zh: 」既入鎮，晟留其達官執室以領其眾，自將染幹馳驛入朝。

translations.literal: " Once they had entered the post, Sheng left Tuli's high official Zhishi to lead the multitude, while he himself escorted Tuli by relay post-horses into court.
translations.idiomatic: " Once inside the post, Sheng left Tuli's high official Zhishi to lead the tribesmen while he himself escorted Tuli by relay to court.

sentences.zh: 帝大喜，進授左勳衛驃騎將軍，持節護突厥。

translations.literal: The emperor was greatly pleased, promoted him to General of Agile Cavalry of the Left Merit Guard, and sent him bearing the staff of authority to oversee the Türks.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor was delighted, promoted him to general of agile cavalry of the Left Merit Guard, and sent him with the staff of authority to oversee the Türks.

sentences.zh: 晟遣降虜覘候雍閭，知其牙內屢有災變，夜見赤虹，光照數百里，天狗隕，雨血三日，流星墜其營內，有聲如雷。

translations.literal: Sheng sent surrendered barbarians to spy on Yunglu and learned that within his royal camp there were repeated portents: at night a red rainbow appeared, its light shining for several hundred li; a sky-dog fell; blood rained for three days; a meteor crashed within his encampment with a sound like thunder.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng sent surrendered Türks to spy on Yunglu and learned that his camp was plagued by omens: a red rainbow at night lit the sky for hundreds of li; a comet fell; blood rained for three days; a meteor crashed in his camp with a thunderous roar.

sentences.zh: 每夜自驚，言隋師且至。

translations.literal: Each night he startled himself, saying Sui troops were about to arrive.
translations.idiomatic: Each night he startled himself, saying that Sui troops were about to arrive.

sentences.zh: 並遣奏知，仍請出討突厥。

translations.literal: He also sent reports to inform the court and again requested permission to campaign against the Türks.
translations.idiomatic: He reported all this to court and again requested permission to campaign against the Türks.

sentences.zh: 都速等歸染幹，前後至者男女萬餘口，晟安置之。

translations.literal: Dusu and others submitted to Tuli; those who arrived before and after, men and women numbering more than ten thousand mouths, Sheng settled and provisioned.
translations.idiomatic: Dusu and others submitted to Tuli; more than ten thousand men and women arrived in succession, and Sheng settled them.

sentences.zh: 由是突厥悅附。

translations.literal: From this the Türks were pleased and attached themselves.
translations.idiomatic: From this the Türks were pleased and submitted willingly.

sentences.zh: 尋以染幹為意利珍豆啟人可汗，賜射于武安殿。

translations.literal: Soon Tuli was made Qaghan Qilibi of the Qiren, and an archery contest was granted at Wuan Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Tuli was made Qaghan Qilibi of the Qiren, and the emperor granted an archery contest at Wuan Hall.

sentences.zh: 選善射者十二人，分為兩朋。

translations.literal: Twelve skilled archers were selected and divided into two teams.
translations.idiomatic: Twelve skilled archers were chosen and divided into two teams.

sentences.zh: 啟人曰：「臣由長孫大使得見天子，今日賜射，願入其朋。

translations.literal: The Qaghan said, "Your servant, through the Grand Master Zhangsun, was able to see the Son of Heaven; today, granted this archery contest, I wish to enter his team."
translations.idiomatic: The Qaghan said, "Through Grand Master Zhangsun I was able to see the Son of Heaven; for today's archery contest I wish to join his team."

sentences.zh: 」許之。

translations.literal: " Permission was granted.
translations.idiomatic: " Permission was granted.

sentences.zh: 給晟箭六侯，發皆入鹿，啟人之朋竟勝。

translations.literal: Sheng was given six arrows of the hou rank; every shot entered the deer target, and the Qaghan's team ultimately won.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng was given six hou-grade arrows; every shot hit the deer target, and the Qaghan's team won.

sentences.zh: 時有群飛，上曰：「公善彈，為我取之。

translations.literal: At the time a flock was flying; the emperor said, "You are skilled with the sling—take them for me."
translations.idiomatic: A flock of birds was flying overhead; the emperor said, "You are skilled with the sling—bring them down for me."

sentences.zh: 」十發俱中，並應丸而落。

translations.literal: " Ten shots all hit, and each fell at the strike of the pellet.
translations.idiomatic: " Ten shots all hit, and every bird fell at the strike of the pellet.

sentences.zh: 是日百官獲賚，晟獨居多。

translations.literal: That day the hundred officials received gifts, but Sheng alone received the most.
translations.idiomatic: That day the officials all received gifts, but Sheng alone received the largest share.

sentences.zh: 尋遣領五萬人，於朔州築大利城以處染幹。

translations.literal: Soon he was sent to lead fifty thousand men to build Dali city at Shuozhou to settle Tuli.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon sent to lead fifty thousand men to build Dali city at Shuozhou to settle Tuli.

sentences.zh: 安義公主死，持節送義城公主，複以妻之。

translations.literal: When Princess Anyi died, he bore the staff of authority to escort Princess Yicheng and again gave her to Tuli as wife.
translations.idiomatic: When Princess Anyi died, he escorted Princess Yicheng with the staff of authority and again gave her to Tuli in marriage.

sentences.zh: 晟又奏：「染幹部落歸者既眾，雖在長城之內，猶被雍閭抄略，往來辛苦，不得甯居。

translations.literal: Sheng again memorialized, "Tuli's tribes who have submitted are already numerous; though they are within the Long Wall, they are still raided by Yunglu; coming and going is toilsome and they cannot dwell in peace."
translations.idiomatic: Sheng memorialized again, "Tuli's submitted tribes are already numerous; though they are within the Great Wall they are still raided by Yunglu and cannot live in peace."

sentences.zh: 請徙五原，以河為固，于夏、勝兩州之間，東西至河，南北四百里，掘為橫塹，令處其內，任情放牧，免於抄略，人必自安。

translations.literal: I request that they be moved to Wuyuan, using the river as a defense; between the two provinces Xia and Sheng, from east to west as far as the river and four hundred li north to south, a transverse trench should be dug so that they dwell within it, grazing at will, free from raids and plunder—the people will surely settle themselves in peace.
translations.idiomatic: I request that they be moved to Wuyuan with the river as their defense; between Xia and Sheng provinces, from the river east and west and four hundred li north and south, a transverse trench should be dug so they may dwell within it and pasture freely, safe from raids—the people will surely settle in peace.

sentences.zh: 」上並從之。

translations.literal: " The emperor approved all of it.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor approved all of it.

sentences.zh: 二十年，都藍大亂，為其部下所殺。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year Dudou fell into great disorder and was killed by his subordinates.
translations.idiomatic: In year 20 Dudou fell into great disorder and was killed by his subordinates.

sentences.zh: 晟因奏請曰：「今王師臨境，戰數有功，賊內攜離，其主被殺，乘此招誘，必並來降，請遣染幹部下分頭招慰。

translations.literal: Sheng thereupon memorialized requesting, "Now that the royal army is at the border and has won repeated victories in battle, the enemy are inwardly divided and their lord has been killed—seizing this opportunity to entice them, they will surely all come to submit; I beg that Tuli's subordinates be sent out separately to summon and comfort them."
translations.idiomatic: Sheng memorialized, "Now that the imperial army is at the border with repeated victories, the enemy are divided within and their lord is dead—if we seize this moment to entice them, they will surely all submit; I beg that Tuli's subordinates be sent out separately to summon and reassure them."

sentences.zh: 」上許之，果盡來附。

translations.literal: " The emperor granted it, and indeed they all came to attach themselves.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor agreed, and indeed they all submitted.

sentences.zh: 達頭恐怖，又大集兵。

translations.literal: Tardu was terrified and again gathered a great army.
translations.idiomatic: Tardu was terrified and again gathered a great army.

sentences.zh: 詔晟部領降人，為秦川行軍總管，取晉王廣節度出討。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Sheng to command the surrendered barbarians as campaign commander of the Qinchuan Circuit, taking his orders from Prince Guang of Jin and advancing to attack.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Sheng to command the surrendered Türks as campaign commander of the Qinchuan Circuit under Prince Guang of Jin and advance to attack.

sentences.zh: 達頭與王相抗，晟進策曰：「突厥飲泉，易可行毒。

translations.literal: Tardu opposed the prince; Sheng advanced a stratagem saying, "The Türks drink from springs—it is easy to poison them."
translations.idiomatic: Tardu opposed the prince; Sheng proposed, "The Türks drink from springs—it would be easy to poison the water."

sentences.zh: 」因取諸藥毒水上流，達頭人畜飲之多死，於是大驚曰：「天雨惡水，其亡我乎？

translations.literal: " He therefore took various drugs and poisoned the upstream waters; many of Tardu's men and livestock died from drinking, and he was greatly alarmed, saying, "Heaven has rained foul water—will it destroy me?"
translations.idiomatic: " He poisoned the upstream waters with drugs; many of Tardu's men and livestock died from drinking, and Tardu cried in alarm, "Heaven has rained foul water—am I doomed?"

sentences.zh: 」因夜遁。

translations.literal: " He therefore fled in the night.
translations.idiomatic: " He fled in the night.

sentences.zh: 晟追之，斬首千餘級，俘百餘口，六畜數千頭。

translations.literal: Sheng pursued him, beheaded more than a thousand, captured more than a hundred persons, and took several thousand head of the six domestic animals.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng pursued him, took more than a thousand heads, captured more than a hundred prisoners, and seized several thousand head of livestock.

sentences.zh: 王大喜，引晟入內，同宴極歡。

translations.literal: The prince was greatly pleased, led Sheng inside, and feasted together in the utmost joy.
translations.idiomatic: The prince was delighted, brought Sheng inside, and feasted with him in great joy.

sentences.zh: 有突厥達官來降，時亦預坐，說言突厥之內，大畏長孫總管，聞其弓聲，謂為霹靂，見其走馬，稱為閃電。

translations.literal: A Türk high official who had come to surrender was also present at the feast and said that within the Türks they greatly feared Area Commander Zhangsun: hearing his bow they called it thunder, and seeing his galloping horse they called it lightning.
translations.idiomatic: A surrendered Türk high official was also at the feast and said that among the Türks they greatly feared Area Commander Zhangsun—his bow was called thunder and his galloping horse lightning.

sentences.zh: 王笑曰：「將軍震怒，威行域外，遂與雷霆為比，一何壯哉！

translations.literal: The prince laughed and said, "The general's wrath shakes the realm; his authority extends beyond the borders, and he is compared with thunder—how magnificent!"
translations.idiomatic: The prince laughed and said, "The general's wrath shakes the realm and his authority extends beyond the borders—he is compared with thunder. How magnificent!"

sentences.zh: 」師旋，授上開府儀同三司，複遣還大利城，安撫新附。

translations.literal: " When the army returned he was appointed Senior Opener of the Gate with ceremony equal to the Three Excellencies, and again sent back to Dali city to comfort and settle the newly submitted.
translations.idiomatic: " When the army returned he was appointed senior opener of the gate with ceremony equal to the Three Excellencies and again sent back to Dali city to settle the newly submitted tribes.

sentences.zh: 仁壽元年，晟表奏曰：「臣夜登城樓，望見磧北有赤氣，長百餘裡，皆如雨足，下垂被地。

translations.literal: In the first year of Renshou Sheng memorialized saying, "Your servant climbed the city tower at night and saw north of the desert a red vapor more than a hundred li long, all like rain shafts hanging down to touch the ground."
translations.idiomatic: In Renshou year 1 Sheng memorialized, "I climbed the city tower at night and saw north of the desert a red vapor more than a hundred li long, like rain shafts hanging down to the ground."

sentences.zh: 謹驗兵書，此名灑血，其下之國必且破亡。

translations.literal: Upon careful checking in military texts, this is called 'spilled blood'; the state beneath it will surely be destroyed.
translations.idiomatic: According to the military texts this omen is called 'spilled blood'; the state beneath it will surely fall.

sentences.zh: 欲滅匈奴，宜在今日。

translations.literal: If we wish to destroy the Xiongnu, today is the time.
translations.idiomatic: If we wish to destroy the Xiongnu, the time is now.

sentences.zh: 」詔楊素為行軍元帥，晟為受降使者，送染幹北伐。

translations.literal: " An edict appointed Yang Su as campaign commander, Sheng as envoy for receiving surrenders, and sent Tuli on a northern campaign.
translations.idiomatic: " An edict appointed Yang Su campaign commander, Sheng envoy for receiving surrenders, and sent Tuli on a northern campaign.

sentences.zh: 二年，軍次北河，值賊帥思力俟斤等領兵拒戰，晟與大將軍梁默擊走之，轉戰六十餘裡，賊眾多降。

translations.literal: In the second year the army halted at North River; it happened that the rebel leaders Silijin and others led troops to resist battle; Sheng and the great general Liang Mo struck and drove them off, fighting for more than sixty li, and many of the enemy surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: In year 2 the army halted at North River; the rebel leaders Silijin and others led troops to resist; Sheng and Great General Liang Mo drove them off in fighting that ranged more than sixty li, and many enemy surrendered.

sentences.zh: 晟又教染幹分遣使者，往北方鐵勒等部招攜取之。

translations.literal: Sheng also instructed Tuli to send out envoys separately to the northern Tiele and other tribes to entice and win them over.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng also instructed Tuli to send envoys to the northern Tiele and other tribes to win them over.

sentences.zh: 三年，有鐵勒、思結、伏利具、渾、斛薩、阿拔、僕骨等十餘部，盡背達頭，請來降附。

translations.literal: In the third year more than ten tribes including Tiele, Sijie, Fuliju, Hun, Husai, Aba, and Pugu all turned against Tardu and requested to come and submit.
translations.idiomatic: In year 3 more than ten tribes including Tiele, Sijie, Fuliju, Hun, Husai, Aba, and Pugu all abandoned Tardu and requested to submit.

sentences.zh: 達頭眾大潰，西奔吐谷渾。

translations.literal: Tardu's forces collapsed in great disorder and fled west to the Tuyuhun.
translations.idiomatic: Tardu's forces collapsed and fled west to the Tuyuhun.

sentences.zh: 晟送染幹安置於磧口。

translations.literal: Sheng escorted Tuli and settled him at Qikou.
translations.idiomatic: Sheng escorted Tuli and settled him at Qikou.

sentences.zh: 事畢，入朝，遇高祖崩，匿喪未發。

translations.literal: When the affair was concluded he entered court and encountered the death of Emperor Gaozu; the mourning was concealed and not yet announced.
translations.idiomatic: When the affair was concluded he entered court just as Emperor Gaozu died; the mourning was concealed and not yet announced.

sentences.zh: 煬帝引晟於大行前委以內衙宿衛，知門禁事，即日拜左領軍將軍。

translations.literal: Emperor Yang brought Sheng before the imperial bier and entrusted him with inner-palace night guard duty and knowledge of gate and barrier affairs; that same day he was appointed General of the Left Army of the Palace Guards.
translations.idiomatic: Emperor Yang brought Sheng before the imperial bier and entrusted him with inner-palace guard duty and control of the gates; that same day he was appointed general of the Left Army of the Palace Guards.

sentences.zh: 遇楊諒作逆，敕以本官為相州刺史，發山東兵馬，與李雄等共經略之。

translations.literal: When Yang Liang rebelled, an edict appointed him in his original office as inspector of Xiang province, mobilized Shandong troops and horses, and together with Li Xiong and others jointly planned strategy against him.
translations.idiomatic: When Yang Liang rebelled, an edict appointed him inspector of Xiang province, mobilized Shandong forces, and sent him with Li Xiong and others to suppress the rebellion.

sentences.zh: 晟辭曰：「有男行布，今在逆地，忽蒙此任，情所不安。

translations.literal: Sheng declined, saying, "I have a son, Xingbu, who is now in the rebel territory; suddenly to receive this appointment is something my feelings cannot accept."
translations.idiomatic: Sheng declined, saying, "My son Xingbu is now in rebel territory; to receive this appointment suddenly is more than I can bear in conscience."

sentences.zh: 」帝曰：「公著勤誠，朕之所悉。

translations.literal: " The emperor said, "Your loyal devotion is what I well know."
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor said, "Your loyal devotion is well known to me."

sentences.zh: 今相州之地，本是齊都，人俗澆浮，易可搔擾。

translations.literal: The territory of Xiang province today was formerly the capital of Qi; the people's customs are shallow and unstable, easily stirred to disturbance.
translations.idiomatic: Xiang province was once the Qi capital; the people are shallow and unstable and easily stirred to revolt.

sentences.zh: 儻生變動，賊勢即張，思所以鎮之，非公莫可。

translations.literal: If trouble should arise, the rebels' power would immediately expand; I consider how to suppress it—no one but you can do this.
translations.idiomatic: If trouble arises the rebels' power will swell at once; I can think of no one but you to hold the region down.

sentences.zh: 公體國之深，終不可以兒害義，故用相委，公其勿辭。

translations.literal: Your regard for the state's welfare runs deep; in the end you cannot let a son harm righteousness—therefore I entrust this to you; do not decline.
translations.idiomatic: Your devotion to the state runs too deep for a son to outweigh duty—therefore I entrust this to you; do not decline.

sentences.zh: 」於是遣捉相州。

translations.literal: " He thereupon dispatched him to seize Xiang province.
translations.idiomatic: " He thereupon dispatched him to take Xiang province.

sentences.zh: 諒破，追還，轉武衛將軍。

translations.literal: When Liang was defeated, Sheng was recalled and transferred to General of the Martial Guards.
translations.idiomatic: When Liang was defeated, Sheng was recalled and made general of the Martial Guards.

sentences.zh: 大業三年，煬帝幸榆林，欲出塞外，陳兵耀武，經突厥中，指於涿郡。

translations.literal: In the third year of Daye Emperor Yang visited Yulin, wished to go beyond the frontier, arrayed troops to display martial might, passed through the Türk lands, and aimed toward Zhuo commandery.
translations.idiomatic: In Daye year 3 Emperor Yang visited Yulin, wished to march beyond the frontier, displayed his armies in martial splendor, passed through Türk territory, and aimed for Zhuo commandery.

sentences.zh: 仍恐染幹驚懼，先遣晟往喻旨，稱述帝意。

translations.literal: Still fearing that Tuli would be alarmed and afraid, he first sent Sheng ahead to explain the imperial intent and set forth the emperor's meaning.
translations.idiomatic: Fearing Tuli would be alarmed, he first sent Sheng ahead to explain the imperial intent.

sentences.zh: 染幹聽之，因召所部諸國，奚、霫、室韋等種落數十酋長咸萃。

translations.literal: Tuli listened and thereupon summoned the various states under his authority; chieftains of several tens of tribes including Xi, Mohe, and Shiwei all gathered.
translations.idiomatic: Tuli listened and summoned the tribes under his authority; chieftains of several dozen Xi, Mohe, Shiwei, and other tribes all gathered.

sentences.zh: 晟以牙中草穢，欲令染乾親自除之，示諸部落，以明威重，乃指帳前草曰：「此根大香。
